_note: Glossary + claim rules for the O.A.S.I.S. Journal. Read by check_claims.py and available to the blog templates as site.data.journal_terms. The Spanish renderings are the ones already used on the published es/ pages: consistency with the existing site beats literal translation.

forbidden.pattern: nada sale de (tu|su) (pc|ordenador|equipo)|nunca sale de|no sale nada de tu pc|nothing ever leaves|sends nothing anywhere
forbidden.why: PRODUCT_TRUTH.md: banned phrasing. The model is local, the app is not network-blind.

forbidden.pattern: completamente offline|totalmente offline|funciona totalmente sin conexi[oó]n|fully offline|100% offline
forbidden.why: PRODUCT_TRUTH.md: only true per feature (chat, voice, memory, documents), never product-wide.

forbidden.pattern: cero actividad de red|zero network activity|sin actividad de red alguna
forbidden.why: PRODUCT_TRUTH.md: web search, weather and integrations do use the network when invoked.
PRODUCT_TRUTH.md: say 'compatible GGUF models', never 'any GGUF runs'.
It predicts text. Keep the mechanism visible instead of anthropomorphising.

forbidden.pattern: max est[aá] a la venta|max is (now )?available|compra max ahora|buy max now
forbidden.why: PRODUCT_TRUTH.md: Max is not on sale yet.

approved.en: Local features run on your PC. Network-enabled features communicate externally only when you use or configure them. O.A.S.I.S. is offline-first, not network-blind.
approved.es: Las funciones locales se ejecutan en tu PC. Las funciones que usan red se comunican externamente solo cuando tú las usas o configuras. O.A.S.I.S. es offline-first, no ciego a la red.

measurement._note: A performance number in a Journal article is only publishable together with a recorded measurement. The article must carry a visible 'How this was measured' block; check_claims.py looks for it.
